name: resonite_protoflux_scripting
description: Create and execute ProtoFlux scripts in Resonite

script_type.description: Type of ProtoFlux script to create

parameters.description: Parameters to pass to the script

execute_immediately.description: Whether to execute the script immediately after creation

template: Create and execute a {script_type} ProtoFlux script named '{script_name}' with parameters {parameters}. Execute immediately: {execute_immediately}.

examples.output: Create an avatar animation ProtoFlux script called 'ColorChanger' that changes avatar color to orange over 2 seconds and execute it immediately.
Create a world interaction ProtoFlux script called 'WelcomeSystem' that displays a welcome message when users come within 5 meters and execute it immediately.
